renew.a: No. You pay once for 3, 6 or 12 months. We email you 14 days and 3 days before it ends, and you decide whether to add more time.

stack.q: What if I buy more while Pro is still on?
stack.a: The new months are added after your current end date, so you never lose a day.

ends.a: You get 7 days of grace. Then your site moves to Free: projects beyond your newest 8, password pages and your own domain are hidden, and the small Fannan credit returns. Nothing is deleted, and it all comes back when you go Pro again.

currency.q: Why do I see EGP or USD?
currency.a: Prices follow your country: Egyptian pounds in Egypt, US dollars everywhere else. The currency is fixed once you start paying.

refund.a: Yes, within 14 days of paying, as long as your site wasn’t published on your own domain. Write to support@fannan.net.

pay.a: By card through Paymob, Egypt’s payment company. Depending on your country you may also see mobile wallets or Fawry.

help.title: Help
help.sub: Short answers to the questions artists ask most.
help.more: Didn’t find your answer? Write to us and a person will reply.

what.a: A portfolio builder for Arab artists and creatives of every kind: illustrators, photographers, designers, animators, architects, fashion designers, calligraphers, filmmakers, musicians and more. You get one link that shows your best work with clear credits, made for the people who hire.

free.a: Yes. The free plan has no time limit: 8 projects, every theme, your yourname.fannan.net address, a contact form and stats for 30 days. Pro adds your own domain, unlimited projects, password pages and full stats.

time.q: How long does it take to make a site?
time.a: A few minutes to get it live. Pick a layout, upload a few projects with credits, press Publish. You can keep improving it any time.

arabic.q: Can my site be in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. In the editor, choose Arabic as your site’s language: the layout flips right to left and uses Arabic fonts. Projects have optional Arabic titles and descriptions.

upload.a: Images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG), short MP4 loops up to 30 seconds, and PDFs like comics or pitch decks. We make web versions automatically and never show your originals.

video.q: How do I add my reel?
video.a: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link in a project or in the Reel block. Fannan doesn’t host long videos; loops up to 30 seconds can be uploaded directly.

publish.q: Why don’t my changes show on my site?
publish.a: Editing never changes your live site until you press Publish in the site editor. That way you can work on it without visitors seeing half-finished pages.

password.q: Can I hide work under NDA?
password.a: Yes. Set a project to Hidden (it opens only by its direct link) or, on Pro, protect a project, a page or the whole site with a password.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes, with Pro. In Settings → Domain type the domain you bought (for example yourname.com). Fannan shows you exactly which records to add at your domain company and turns on SSL by itself.

seo.a: Yes. Every page has a real title and description, a sitemap and share images. You can turn indexing off in Settings → Privacy.

available.a: It shows a badge and a “Hire me” button on your site, straight away, without publishing again. Turn it off when you’re busy.

messages.a: Into Messages in your dashboard, and to your email too unless you turn that off in Settings. Reply by email with one click.

stats.a: By Fannan itself, without cookies and without storing anyone’s IP address. Bots don’t count. You can also add your own Google Analytics ID.

username.a: Yes, in Settings → Domain. Your old address keeps forwarding visitors to the new one for 30 days.

export.q: Can I take my work with me?
export.a: Always. Settings → Integrations → Export my site gives you a zip with every original file and your texts.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Settings → Account. Your site goes offline at once and everything is deleted for good after 14 days. Log in before then if you change your mind.

pay.q: How do I pay for Pro?
pay.a: Once, for 3, 6 or 12 months, by card through Paymob. Nothing renews by itself. See the Pricing page for details.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Fannan when you use fannan.net, app.fannan.net and the sites made with Fannan.

p: Fannan is operated by Big Cat Animation LLC, Cairo, Egypt (“Fannan”, “we”). You can reach us at support@fannan.net.
You need to be at least 16 years old to make a Fannan account. Keep your sign-in email secure; you’re responsible for what happens on your account.
One person per account. Your username must follow our rules (no offensive or misleading names) and we may take back names that are reserved or used to impersonate someone.

You own everything you upload. You give Fannan a limited permission to store, copy, resize and show your work so we can run your site, make web versions of your files and show your site where you choose (for example in previews and, if you agree, on our Examples page).
This permission ends when you delete the work or your account, except for copies in backups that are deleted on their normal schedule.
You may only post work you made or have the right to show, and you must follow our Content policy, which is part of these terms. Artistic nudity and mature themes are allowed; pornography is not.
We may hide work, unpublish a site or suspend an account that breaks these rules, and we’ll tell you why.

The Free plan has no time limit. Pro is paid once for 3, 6 or 12 months and never renews automatically. Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds in Egypt and US dollars elsewhere; the currency is fixed when you start paying.

Buying more Pro while it’s active adds the time after your current end date. When Pro ends you have 7 days of grace; then your site moves to Free and anything Free doesn’t include is hidden, not deleted.
Refunds: within 14 days of paying, as long as your site wasn’t published on your own domain. Write to support@fannan.net.
You’re responsible for the domain you connect and its renewal with your domain company. If Pro ends, your domain stops showing your site and visitors are sent to your Fannan address.
You can delete your account in Settings at any time. Your site goes offline at once and everything is deleted after 14 days. You can export your site before that.
We may end accounts that seriously or repeatedly break these terms.
We work hard to keep Fannan fast and online, but we can’t promise it will never be interrupted. We may change or improve features; if a change takes away something you paid for, we’ll make it right.
Fannan is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we aren’t liable for indirect losses, and our total liability is limited to what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
If we change these terms in a way that matters, we’ll tell you by email or in your dashboard before the change takes effect.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt, and the courts of Cairo handle any dispute, unless the law of your country gives you other rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why, and what you can do about it. Short version: we collect what we need to run your portfolio, we don’t sell anything to anyone, and visitor stats work without cookies.

p: Big Cat Animation LLC, Cairo, Egypt, operates Fannan. Contact: support@fannan.net.

Your sign-in email, your name, your username and your plan; what you put on your site (work, credits, texts, settings); your payment records (amount, date, months bought). We never see or store your card number: Paymob handles payments.
Basic technical logs (for example errors and security events), kept for a short time.

sections.h: What we collect from visitors to artist sites
p: Visitor counts without cookies: we turn the visitor’s IP address and browser into a scrambled code that changes every day and can’t be reversed. We don’t store IP addresses for stats. We record the page, the site that sent the visitor and the country (from Cloudflare).

If a visitor uses a contact form, the artist receives their name, email and message. Artists may add their own Google Analytics or Meta Pixel; then those companies’ policies apply on that artist’s site.
On app.fannan.net we use a sign-in cookie and a language cookie. On artist sites, a cookie is only set when you enter a password for a protected page. We don’t use advertising cookies.

To run your account and site, deliver messages, process payments, prevent spam and abuse, send the emails you need (sign-in links, receipts, reminders) and improve Fannan. We don’t sell personal data and don’t use it for advertising.
Google Cloud and Firebase (hosting, database and files, in Belgium), Cloudflare (network and security), Resend (email) and Paymob (payments). They only process data for us, under contract.
As long as your account exists. When you delete your account, everything is deleted after 14 days; backups are overwritten within a few weeks. Payment records are kept as long as tax law requires.

You can see and change your information in your dashboard, export your site at any time, stop email copies of messages, turn off search indexing and delete your account. Write to support@fannan.net for anything else, including access to or correction of your data.
Fannan isn’t for children under 16, and we don’t knowingly collect their data.
We’ll tell you by email or in your dashboard before important changes to this policy.

policy.title: Content policy
policy.intro: Artists are free to show what’s in their portfolio. That includes artistic nudity, violence in film or game work and mature themes. Pornography isn’t allowed, and the standard rules every hosting platform has apply.

p: Artistic nudity: figure drawing, life studies, anatomy, fine art, character design.
Mature themes, horror, violence, gore, and political or religious subjects in artistic and professional work.
Work for clients, with your credit, when you have the right to show it.
Pornography: sexually explicit content whose main purpose is sexual arousal, and sexual services.

Any sexual or sexualised content involving minors, including drawn, animated or AI-generated depictions. Zero tolerance: removed at once, account suspended, records kept and reported to the authorities as the law requires.
Content that’s illegal in Egypt or where it’s viewed.
Hate: attacking or dehumanising people for their religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability and similar.
Threats, harassment and incitement to violence against real people.
Other people’s private information, and intimate images shared without consent.
Someone else’s work shown as your own.
Impersonating a real person, studio or brand.
Spam, scams, phishing, malware, or using a Fannan site to collect passwords or payments under false pretences.

You can mark a project as mature. Visitors then see a short notice before the images load. This is your choice, never required for artistic nudity; it’s a courtesy for when you send your link to studios.
Every Fannan site has a “Report this site” link at the bottom. Reports are private and reviewed by a person.
If your own work is shown without permission, send a copyright notice at fannan.net/copyright. We hide the work after a complete notice, and the artist can reply with a counter-notice.
Depending on what we find: no action, hiding a project, unpublishing a site, suspending an account or, for serious or repeated cases, closing it. We email the artist with the reason each time.
